jobs.title: Founding Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description_text: ABOUT ADAPTIVE NVIDIA and OpenAI’s only AI cybersecurity investment. Adaptive is a cybersecurity startup on a mission to stop AI-powered cyberattacks. ROLE We are seeking our 2nd ML Engineer to define and build Adaptive's ML capabilities. Our products use LLMs and ML models to detect, classify, and respond to cybersecurity threats in real time. The ML problems here are adversarial by nature. Attackers actively evolve to evade detection, labeled data is scarce for novel attack vectors, and models need to operate at production scale with strict latency constraints. We don't have dedicated ML infrastructure or an ML team today. You'll be building this from the ground up. You will set the technical direction, stand up the infrastructure, and do the hands-on work yourself. You’ll be instrumental in growing the function as our ML surface area expands this year and beyond. COMPENSATION Adaptive has raised $146M from top-tier investors including BCV, a16z, NVIDIA, and OpenAI. Our roadmap depends on standing up an ML function that doesn’t yet exist, and we’re ready to compensate accordingly. Expect market level compensation and huge ownership over the ML platform from day one. RESPONSIBILITIES - Define Adaptive's ML strategy: where ML should be applied across our products, what infrastructure we need, and how we should approach build vs. buy decisions. - Design and build production ML systems end-to-end — data pipelines, model training, evaluation frameworks, and inference serving. -

Our pioneering work in human computation, synthetic data, simulation and RL give us the advantage in delivering results to our customers. Why now? jobs.title: Senior Motor-Generator Engineer
jobs.description_text: About the Role: As a Senior Motor-Generator Engineer, you will own the design and development of high-speed motor-generator units (MGUs) for Antares nuclear reactors. You will serve as the primary technical interface with our electric-machine suppliers while developing the internal capability to design, analyze, manufacture, and test stators and permanent-magnet rotors. You will work closely with electrical, turbomachinery, mechanical design, manufacturing, and test engineers to integrate the MGU into our power conversion systems. The ideal candidate has experience designing electric motors or generators, with strong knowledge of electromagnetic design, materials, manufacturing processes, and hardware testing. You can make sound engineering tradeoffs between electrical performance, mechanical integrity, thermal limits, reliability, manufacturability, cost, and schedule. Roles & Responsibilities: - Own the technical development of high-speed motor-generator units from design through qualification and production. - Serve as the primary technical interface with electric-machine suppliers, reviewing designs, analyses, manufacturing processes, and test results. - Develop motor-generator requirements, specifications, interfaces, and verification plans. - Perform electromagnetic design and analysis of electric machines, including machine sizing, winding configurations, magnetic circuits, losses, efficiency, and operating limits. - Design stator and rotor components, including lamina

You will translate program needs into equipment and facility requirements, bring new capabilities online, and establish a practical path from test request to reliable results. You will work closely with Facilities, test teams, design engineering, and Quality to make the lab useful, safe, and ready for a growing hardware development program. Roles & Responsibilities: Build the environmental lab capability roadmap with test and design teams, identifying near-term needs, future capacity, and gaps best covered by external labs. For shakers, evaluate payload and fixture mass, force, frequency, displacement, velocity, and control requirements. Work with Facilities to define and coordinate power, cooling water, ventilation, compressed air, floor loading, vibration isolation, rigging access, and equipment layout before installation. We believe neuroscience and AI will converge in embodied intelligence: animals and robots face shared challenges of perceiving their surroundings, navigating, manipulating objects, and using memory and reasoning to accomplish tasks in the physical world. Robotics provides a powerful testbed for investigating how biological neural circuits solve these challenges and for developing AI systems that turn perception, learning, and cognition into effective action. Our strategy starts with making robots useful, while developing a mechanistic understanding of how neural circuits can generate intelligent behavior. We aim to continually expand the repertoire of behaviors a robot can perform reliably in real environments, while improving its ability to learn new skills, adapt to changing conditions, and recover from failure. These practical capabilities provide both measurable outcomes and a foundation for investigating deeper principles of intelligence. jobs.title: Research Specialist, Experimental Neuroscience
jobs.description_text: COMPANY OVERVIEW Astera Neuro seeks to understand and engineer consciousness. We believe consciousness is the process by which the brain builds a coherent internal model of the world and the self. We aim to understand this model and to develop the technologies to write experience directly into the brain. By combining large-scale neural recording, causal perturbation, and brain-based AI, we seek to move neuroscience from observing correlates of experience to engineering it. The same tools carry direct therapeutic promise for neurological and psychiatric diseases that alter perception, thought, and sense of self. Because the science and tools required do not yet exist, we are assembling a founding team of neuroscientists, theorists, and engineers to create them. We do high-risk, high-reward science in a well-resourced, collaborative environment with competitive pay, and share everything openly under Astera's Open Science Policy. POSITION SUMMARY We are seeking Research Specialists to help carry out experiments investigating how the brain supports perception, cognition, and behavior. Working alongside scientists, engineers, and technicians, you will support the day-to-day experimental work of our neuroscience team, preparing and running experiments, training animals, and maintaining experimental setups. jobs.description_text: "Bring hands-on regulatory judgment to AI that runs the registered life of a product." ■ About Cheiron Cheiron is building AI software for regulatory lifecycle management in the pharmaceutical industry, and we are working with our first pilot customers. The platform keeps track of what is registered in each market (the approved state, commitments and conditions, and the filings needed to keep registrations current) and, when a manufacturing or quality change is proposed, works out what it means in each market for review by qualified regulatory staff. It also drafts and checks regulatory documents. Customers keep their own regulatory records, and their qualified staff make the formal decisions; Cheiron supports that work. Cheiron raised an $11 million seed round led by Menlo Ventures, bringing total funding to $16 million to date, with the backing and strategic support of industry veterans including Moderna co-founder and MIT Institute Professor Robert Langer, former Pfizer Chief Medical Officer Freda Lewis-Hall, Chai Discovery co-founder and CEO Josh Meier, former Starbucks CEO Laxman Narasimhan, and former Apple AI chief John Giannandrea. ■ About the Role You will work alongside AI that produces first drafts, assessments and checks. Your judgment decides what is right, and your work makes the system better. jobs.description_text: THE ROLE Container runtimes were designed for general-purpose software workloads. AI inference is not a general-purpose workload. The tools the industry has relied on for a decade weren’t built for this, and patching around those limitations at higher layers only goes so far. Baseten owns the entire pipeline, from the moment a developer pushes a model to the moment a request gets a response. That vertical ownership means we can fix these problems at the root. As Engineering Manager for Storage Products on the Runtime Fabric team, you will lead the engineers who build and run the storage products behind that stack: the Baseten Delivery Network (BDN), which sits in the cold start path of every model on the platform, the snapshotters and filesystems that expose model weights and container images to a running container, and the storage that model deployment and training need next. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Compute & Isolation
jobs.description_text: THE ROLE Every agent on Baseten Sandboxes gets its own microVM, where it writes and runs code, calls tools, and keeps state across long tasks. Agents pause and resume constantly, so the machine underneath has to start, stop, snapshot, fork, and resume fast, and keep every tenant isolated while it does. General-purpose virtualization was not built for that workload. The Agent Infra team builds that layer. Sandboxes run in microVMs with custom Linux kernels on bare-metal servers we operate. You'll own how sandboxes start, stop, snapshot, fork, and resume, and how they perform on each host's CPU and memory, down to the hardware. You'll also own the guest and host side of each sandbox: its identity, how it attaches to different storage classes for performance or capabilities, and the virtual devices that connect it securely to the network. In September 2026, Baseten acquired Blaxel https://www.baseten.co/blog/blaxel-is-joining-baseten-to-build-the-future-of-agentic-cloud/, whose microVM sandboxes are the foundation for Baseten Sandboxes https://docs.baseten.co/sandboxes. The team is small and ownership is big: we ship in weeks and months, not multi-year programs. jobs.description_text: THE ROLE Every agent on Baseten Sandboxes runs in its own microVM. Agents call models, reach tools and APIs, expose services, and more and more often talk to each other. Networking built into today's cloud providers was not designed for very large numbers of isolated machines that suspend, resume, and exchange data constantly. The Agent Infra team builds its own networking stack for sandboxes, designed from the start for that scale. It runs in user space, with VPP (FD.io http://FD.io) as its main data plane technology, and is built from virtualized network functions (VNF/NFV): carrier-grade, low-latency packet processing designed for very large numbers of agents. You'll build multi-tenant virtual private networking that connects each customer's agents and services privately and securely, using modern overlay technologies. We are building a cloud, not just using one. We want engineers who expose the network as a programmable API and write the code, not operators who push router and switch configuration. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Storage Systems (Agent Infra)
jobs.description_text: THE ROLE Storage decides how fast agent sandboxes start and how safely they share data. Agents need a filesystem that thousands of sandboxes mount at the same time, with strict isolation and the consistency agents need. Agent context is mostly small files, so the access patterns look very different from storage built for large files. The Agent Infra team builds Agent Drive, the distributed filesystem that agent sandboxes mount over FUSE, and the storage underneath it. The work uses tiered caching, replication, content-addressed data, and Linux filesystem internals. In September 2026, Baseten acquired Blaxel https://www.baseten.co/blog/blaxel-is-joining-baseten-to-build-the-future-of-agentic-cloud/, whose sandboxes and Agent Drive filesystem are the foundation for Baseten Sandboxes https://docs.baseten.co/sandboxes. We are building a cloud, not just using one, so storage is designed for many tenants from day one. The team is small and ownership is big: we ship in weeks and months, not multi-year programs. If you care about page cache coherency, FUSE, replication protocols, and content-addressable storage, we'd love to talk.
